_schema: Each entry: id, category, title, blurb, url (plain link), affiliate_url (used instead of url when set), featured (sorts first + badge), label (honest disclosure shown on the card, e.g. 'From the makers of Bookish Club', 'Sponsored'), sponsored (true = paid placement, must carry a label), status ('live' renders; 'slot' is a reserved placement that never renders until filled), internal (true = our own page, url is a site path).
categories: Free questions and notes for almost any book your club picks.
Buy local where you can, borrow where you can't.
For the members who read on the commute.
Your library card goes further than you think.
Small things that make a meeting easy to run and easy to come back to.
Simple things to print at home.
Extras we think book clubs might enjoy.

entries.title: LitLovers reading guides
entries.blurb: A long-running free library of discussion questions, searchable by title and author.

entries.title: Reading Group Choices
entries.blurb: Free publisher-provided guides and book club picks, updated through the year.

entries.title: Bookshop.org
entries.blurb: Order online and a share of the sale goes to independent bookstores. Good for a whole club's copies.

entries.title: Find an indie bookstore
entries.blurb: The American Booksellers Association's map of independent bookstores. Many give club discounts if you ask.

entries.title: Libro.fm
entries.blurb: Audiobooks bought through a bookstore you choose, so your listening supports a local shop.

entries.title: Libby
entries.blurb: Borrow ebooks and audiobooks free with a library card. Join the holds list early: popular picks have waits.

entries.title: Hoopla
entries.blurb: Instant library borrowing with no waitlist, if your library offers it.

entries.title: How to host a book club that lasts
entries.blurb: Our short guide: picking books, setting the rhythm, keeping the talk going and welcoming new faces.

entries.title: Snack and wine pairings by genre
entries.blurb: Easy themed menus for mystery nights, romance picks, fantasy epics and more.

entries.title: Printable bookmarks and RSVP cards
entries.blurb: Fill in your club's next date and book, print at home, cut along the lines.

entries.title: Fictora
entries.blurb: Talk to the characters from your club's book. An app for after the meeting, when the conversation isn't quite finished.
